run_batch_updates_example: run the batch updates example executable against a MySQL host with salary and name updates
run_runner_with_updates: run the _Runner class with a list of update flags like salary and company-id
run_main_cli: run the main CLI function with an executable path and database host as arguments
review_runner_class: review the _Runner class that constructs and executes subprocess commands for batch updates
refactor_runner_credentials: refactor the _Runner class to accept credentials as parameters instead of hardcoded values
